stops.name: Aizkorri-Aratz Natural Park
stops.detail: The Aizkorri-Aratz Natural Park is the second-largest natural park in the Basque Country. Straddling the Cantabrian-Mediterranean watershed, it is named Aizkorri and Aratz, the two most notable mountains in the park. Declared a natural park in [dated source], the area contains limestone mountains and as well as dense beech forests.
